verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee has no documented preset tuned for research agents, but it does offer the pieces: `mode=auto` picks a working configuration automatically, `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` and markdown output give structured, agent-friendly content, and the Gemini API returns citation objects when available. A user would still have to assemble these by hand. Missing for 10: a named research-agent preset or profile, citable output (source attribution) across the scraping/search APIs rather than only via Gemini, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
